name: Pyramid · Desert Gate
_design: Mummy Pyramid zone (level-designer 2026-11-17; Boss: mummies live ONLY here; finished to the goblin camp's level 2026-11-17). Generated by tools/maps/build_mummy_pyramid.gd (edit the script, not this file): Desert entrance on a floating island: the board is drifted sand crossed by a paved causeway (west-east, the line of the fight) with a spur north to the pylon gate in the island's weathered sandstone enclosure wall (north, east, west; the front is an open cliff). Two small pyramids stand in the back corners, obelisks and Anubis statues flank the gate, banners hang on the walls, dunes drift against them, scrub, urns and fallen stones on the margins. Cover: two toppled sandstone blocks shield the archer and the mage (far right). Monster ids/levels here are a fixture: the real waves come from data/journeys/mummy_waves.json and take the spots in list order (melee, knights, then the ranged ones).
_arena: Board 16 x 9 m like the goblin boards. Cover: 2 low blocks (1.5-1.6 m: too high to jump on, low enough to see over) on the monster side; they stop projectiles both ways (logic/projectiles.gd) and the ranged monsters step aside for a clear line (logic/enemy_ai.gd). The middle and the squad's half stay open (logic/auto_pilot.gd walks straight at its target).
_spots: Spot roles in order: melee, melee, melee, melee, knight, knight, archer, mage
